SorrageRoom.1: A box of fuses... one slot is empty
SorrageRoom.2: A spare fuse. This could come in handy
SorrageRoom.3: The drawer is locked, there is a quiz on the desk
SorrageRoom.5: The drawer is locked, maybe the quiz on the desk opens it
SorrageRoom.7: The drawer is open, there is a green stone inside
SorrageRoom.9: A green stone... one step closer
SorrageRoom.11: Who is the teacher that taught biology?
SorrageRoom.15: How many years did the ghost teacher wait for the homework?
SorrageRoom.19: How many ingredients are in the sandwich?

FrontDesk.msg_1: Welcome to THUAS where screaming becomes Screamazing!
FrontDesk.story_1: Late in the evening. The front doors of THUAS fall shut behind you.
FrontDesk.story_2: You only came back for the laptop you left in class. The building should be empty by now.
FrontDesk.story_3: It is not. A single lamp burns at the reception desk, and someone is still writing.
FrontDesk.story_4: At the far end of the corridor a figure stands watching. You blink. It has not moved.
FrontDesk.story_5: Oh. A student, at this hour.
FrontDesk.story_6: The doors lock at ten. They will not open again until the building lets you go.
FrontDesk.story_7: Five rooms on this floor each keep a stone. Bring all five to the golden chest in the teachers' lounge.
FrontDesk.story_8: Be polite to whoever you meet in there. Some of them have been waiting a very long time.
FrontDesk.story_9: Now, I need a name for the visitor log.

VampireRoom.1: Ah... a warm little visitor, wandering into my biology class.
VampireRoom.2: Those shutters have kept the sun out for centuries.
VampireRoom.3: You'll never get them open without power to that old panel.
VampireRoom.4: That panel is your only way to open those shutters.
VampireRoom.5: if you don't stop annoying me, I will kill you
VampireRoom.6: Found a circle figure in the cabinet.
VampireRoom.7: I need to find a fuse first.
VampireRoom.8: Slotted the last fuse into place. All three are lit now.
VampireRoom.9: All three fuses need to be in before I hit this.
VampireRoom.10: *click* — the panel hums back to life.
VampireRoom.11: Something outside screamed. I should go look.

GhostRoom.1: Ohh a student has finally come to class.
GhostRoom.2: I have been waiting for the homework since I died.
GhostRoom.3: Only by handing in your homework can you leave.
GhostRoom.4: Is that my homework? HAND IT OVER.
GhostRoom.5: No homework, no leaving. Search the room.
GhostRoom.7: The classroom is empty. He is really gone.
GhostRoom.8: He left something behind on the desk.
GhostRoom.9: I already collected the stone in my inventory.
GhostRoom.10: A white stone... one step closer to freedom.
GhostRoom.11: It is locked, there is a keypad on the front.
GhostRoom.12: Type the four digit code into the keypad.
GhostRoom.16: Old homework covered in dust, this must be it.
GhostRoom.17: I already gave it to the teacher.
GhostRoom.18: I don't have the homework yet.
GhostRoom.20: At last ... after 347 years class is dismissed
GhostRoom.21: A cold, empty classroom. Rows of dusty desks face the front.
GhostRoom.22: There is a tall cabinet in the corner, a whiteboard on the wall in the top middle, and the ghost teacher sitting behind his desk on the right.
GhostRoom.23: Back in the classroom. The cabinet, the whiteboard and the teacher's desk are all within reach.
GhostRoom.24: The classroom feels lighter now. The desk on the right stands empty.
GhostRoom.25: A ghost teacher floats behind his desk, still grading homework that was handed in decades ago.
GhostRoom.26: His desk is bare now. Only scattered papers and something small and pale are left behind.
GhostRoom.27: A large whiteboard hangs on the wall, with something scrawled across it.
GhostRoom.28: Four digits are written in the corner: 4537. I should remember that.
GhostRoom.29: A metal cabinet stands in the corner. The word HOMEWORK is painted across the doors.
GhostRoom.30: A small keypad is mounted on the front, four empty slots waiting for a code.
GhostRoom.31: The cabinet doors stand open. On the middle shelf lies a thick stack of papers.
GhostRoom.32: The cabinet stands open and empty. Nothing but dust on the shelves.
GhostRoom.33: Close up on the keypad. Twelve worn keys: zero to nine, C to clear and E to enter.
GhostRoom.34: The teacher has turned into a stone. It lies on the empty desk.
GhostRoom.35: There is nothing left in the room.

ProjectRoom.intro_1: A student project room. Beanbags, a bookshelf, a whiteboard and a locked box. It looks like somebody left in the middle of a sentence.
ProjectRoom.binder: A project binder: THE ECHO ENGINE, group 7, final presentation. Three names on the cover, all scratched out. The last page is one long smear of ink.
ProjectRoom.phone: A phone is wedged between the beanbags. One unplayed voicemail.
ProjectRoom.voicemail_1: Hey, it's Mina. We're running late. Please, don't let anyone start the machine without us.
ProjectRoom.voicemail_2: It's Mina again. Someone scattered our badges around the building. Without them the box won't open, and we can't present.
ProjectRoom.board: The whiteboard still has group 7's plan on it, in three different handwritings.
ProjectRoom.board_mina: Mina, designer: "We go round and round until it's perfect."
ProjectRoom.board_jorn: Jorn, builder: "A square deal. Everything built straight."
ProjectRoom.box: A locked box with three slots. Under each slot is a name: Mina, Jorn and Sam.
ProjectRoom.box_nobadges: I have no badges. Group 7 must have left them somewhere else in the building.
ProjectRoom.pick_first: I should pick up a badge first.
ProjectRoom.pickup: Badge in hand. Which slot does it belong to?
ProjectRoom.wrong: It doesn't fit. That badge belongs to someone else.
ProjectRoom.open: All three badges are in. The box hums and the lid lifts.
ProjectRoom.stone: Inside lies a purple stone, warm like the end of a long day.
ProjectRoom.stone_taken: You pick up the purple stone. Group 7 can finally present.
ProjectRoom.box_empty: The box is empty now. Only a faint hum is left.
ProjectRoom.intro_done: The project room is quiet. Group 7 finally got to present.

EquinoxRoom.intro_empty: * Crumbs on an empty table. Nobody here.
EquinoxRoom.intro_gone: * The student is gone. A yellow stone and a small badge lie on the long table.
EquinoxRoom.intro_waiting: * The student waits at the long table. Hungry.
EquinoxRoom.intro_1: * The room smells of toasted bread.
EquinoxRoom.intro_2: * A student sits at the long table, chewing.
EquinoxRoom.talk_2: Make me a sandwich. Everything is lying around this room.
EquinoxRoom.talk_3: Bring it to the plate. The order matters.
EquinoxRoom.talk_4: Two mistakes I forgive. The third I don't.
EquinoxRoom.place: * You put the {name} on the plate.
EquinoxRoom.mistake_1: Wrong. Do not insult the sandwich.
EquinoxRoom.mistake_2: Careful. One more and you're the filling.
EquinoxRoom.fail_2: * The lights die. Something drags you backwards.
EquinoxRoom.complete_1: * The student takes the sandwich and eats it in one bite.
EquinoxRoom.complete_2: * The air turns heavy. His shadow grows horns.
EquinoxRoom.complete_4: Did you really think I was a student?
EquinoxRoom.complete_5: I have eaten in this room for 400 years.
EquinoxRoom.complete_6: Keep the stone. We will meet again...
EquinoxRoom.lookaway_1: * You blink. He's gone. Only crumbs are left.
EquinoxRoom.lookaway_2: * On the long table lies a yellow stone and, next to it, a small triangular badge.
EquinoxRoom.shape: * A small triangular badge, cold and heavy. Cut diagonally, like a sandwich.
EquinoxRoom.stone: * You pick up the stone. Warm as fresh toast.

TeacherRoom.1: A dark teachers' lounge. The candles have burned low and the air smells of wax and old paper.
TeacherRoom.2: A long table buried under papers fills the middle, old couches and bookshelves line the left wall, and a chalkboard hangs on the back wall between the lockers.
TeacherRoom.3: On the right, on a dark red rug, a golden chest sits glowing. It is the only thing in here that gives off its own light.
TeacherRoom.4: Back in the lounge. The chest still waits on the rug to the right.
TeacherRoom.5: Back in the lounge. The chest stands open, its glow slowly fading.
TeacherRoom.6: Up close the chest is solid gold, carved with vines and grinning faces. The floor around it is scorched.
TeacherRoom.7: Five diamond shaped holes are cut into the lid, each one the exact shape of a stone.
TeacherRoom.8: Five holes... five stones. One from every room.
TeacherRoom.9: All five holes are filled. The lid is humming.
TeacherRoom.10: The lid will not budge. Five stones are still missing.
TeacherRoom.11: The lid will not budge. Four stones are still missing.
TeacherRoom.12: The lid will not budge. Three stones are still missing.
TeacherRoom.13: The lid will not budge. Two stones are still missing.
TeacherRoom.14: The lid will not budge. One stone is still missing.
TeacherRoom.15: The white stone sinks into the first hole and locks with a click.
TeacherRoom.16: The red stone sinks into the second hole and locks with a click.
TeacherRoom.17: The green stone sinks into the third hole and locks with a click.
TeacherRoom.18: The purple stone sinks into the fourth hole and locks with a click.
TeacherRoom.19: The yellow stone sinks into the last hole and locks with a click.
TeacherRoom.20: I have no stone that fits. The other rooms must still be hiding some.
TeacherRoom.22: *clunk* - the lock turns itself and the heavy lid swings open.
TeacherRoom.23: Golden light spills out over the stone floor.
TeacherRoom.24: Inside, on folded red velvet, lies a silver necklace with a dark stone pendant.
TeacherRoom.25: A necklace... it is still warm. This has to be the way out.
TeacherRoom.26: The chest is empty now. Nothing but crumpled velvet and dust.

NewRooms.lab2001R.window: You pull two slats apart and look out. Only darkness, and your own reflection staring back.
NewRooms.lab2001R.window.changed: A pale face slams against the glass. You jump back. Best not to think about it anymore.
NewRooms.lab2001R.whiteboard: Half-wiped network diagrams. Someone circled one machine in red.
NewRooms.lab2001R.whiteboard.changed: 'GET OUT', in red. The marker in the tray is bone dry.
NewRooms.lab2001R.server_rack: The server rack is still humming. Little lights blink in a pattern that almost looks deliberate.
NewRooms.lab2001R.server_rack.changed: One drive bay is empty, labeled 'MARSH-ARCHIVE'. Whatever was stored here, someone took it.
NewRooms.lab2001R.metal_cabinet: Locked. Something inside shifts when you knock.
NewRooms.lab2001R.metal_cabinet.changed: A fuse, burnt black and cracked. Useless. A label on the shelf says: 'Spares: where the supplies are kept.'
NewRooms.lab2001R.computers: Rows of dead monitors. One of them flickers on for a second, then goes dark.
NewRooms.lab2001R.computers.changed: The screen asks for a password. Hint: five letters. What it does at windows.
NewRooms.lab2001R.computers.log: ACCESS GRANTED. Maintenance log: 'Power cut at 21:40. Spare fuses are kept with the supplies. The showcase piece never leaves the projects.' The last line reads: 'It watches.'
NewRooms.frontDeskR.window: You pull two slats apart and look out. Only darkness, and your own reflection staring back.
NewRooms.frontDeskR.window.changed: Someone is standing under the lamp. Not moving.
NewRooms.frontDeskR.filing_cabinets: Student files, alphabetical. Your own folder is missing.
NewRooms.frontDeskR.filing_cabinets.changed: One folder is red. All the others are brown.
NewRooms.frontDeskR.reception_desk: The front desk. The computer asks for a password and the bell is sticky.
NewRooms.frontDeskR.reception_desk.changed: A visitor badge. The name on it is yours.
NewRooms.frontDeskR.key_cabinet: Dozens of keys on little hooks. Most of the labels have been scratched off.
NewRooms.frontDeskR.key_cabinet.changed: Every hook has a key. Except slot TR1.
NewRooms.frontDeskR.wall_clock: The clock has stopped. It still ticks.
NewRooms.frontDeskR.wall_clock.changed: Midnight. It was ten past ten a moment ago.
NewRooms.frontDeskR.printer: The printer is warm. The last page is completely black.
NewRooms.frontDeskR.printer.changed: A photo printed from the security camera. Nothing else.
NewRooms.frontDeskR.necklace_missing: I have nothing to give her yet.
NewRooms.class2021R.window: You pull two slats apart and look out. Only darkness, and your own reflection staring back.
NewRooms.class2021R.window.changed: Handprints on the outside of the window, climbing up the glass. Don't think about whose they are. Find a way out.
NewRooms.class2021R.teacher_desk: An old computer on the teacher's desk. The cursor blinks, waiting.
NewRooms.class2021R.teacher_desk.changed: A stack of graded papers. Every one says 'SEE ME' in red. You'd rather not.
NewRooms.class2021R.chalkboard: The chalkboard was wiped in a hurry. Something is still written on it.
NewRooms.class2021R.chalkboard.changed: Someone started a game of hangman. Five letters: W _ T C H. The stick figure is almost finished. One letter is still missing.
NewRooms.class2021R.fridge: An old fridge in a classroom. There is a handprint on the door.
NewRooms.class2021R.fridge.changed: You should not have looked. The freezer is empty. Only frost, a label that says 'Jar 7', and a small handprint on the inside of the door, still melting.
NewRooms.class2021R.notice_board: Timetables, a lost-and-found note, and a class photo with one face cut out.
NewRooms.class2021R.notice_board.changed: A class photo. Every face scratched out except one. The caption says 'Mr. Marsh'. He is looking at you.
NewRooms.teach4R.window: You pull two slats apart and look out. Only darkness, and your own reflection staring back.
NewRooms.teach4R.window.changed: Rain. You did not hear any rain.
NewRooms.teach4R.sofa: A cracked leather sofa. The cushion is still warm.
NewRooms.teach4R.sofa.changed: A pocket watch under the cushion, still ticking.
NewRooms.teach4R.coffee_table: Cold coffee and a half-finished crossword. Every answer is the same word.
NewRooms.teach4R.coffee_table.changed: The mug is knocked over. That is not coffee on the newspaper.
NewRooms.teach4R.meeting_table: A long meeting table. Six chairs, none of them pushed in.
NewRooms.teach4R.meeting_table.changed: A floor plan. One room is circled, and it is not on the door signs.
NewRooms.teach4R.coffee_machine: The coffee machine gurgles by itself. You decide you are not thirsty.
NewRooms.teach4R.bookshelf: Teaching manuals and yearbooks. One year is missing from the row.
NewRooms.teach4R.bookshelf.changed: A hollowed out yearbook with a vial inside.
NewRooms.class2031R.window: You pull two slats apart and look out. Only darkness, and your own reflection staring back.
NewRooms.class2031R.window.changed: A full moon. There was no moon when you came in. Check the weather in 2.015.
NewRooms.class2031R.teacher_desk: A grade book lies open on the desk. Every single mark is a fail.
NewRooms.class2031R.teacher_desk.changed: A seating chart. One name is circled in red: Mr. Marsh. You already know that name.
NewRooms.class2031R.globe: You spin the globe. It stops with your finger on a place that does not exist.
NewRooms.class2031R.globe.changed: The globe opens. A note inside: 'Don't look out. Look down.'
NewRooms.class2031R.globe.flyer: A crumpled flyer on the floor: 'Biology room 2.015 has been rebuilt.'
NewRooms.class2031R.globe.pov_taken: The globe opens. A note inside: 'Don't look out. Look down.'
NewRooms.class2031R.projector: An old slide projector. The last slide is still inside.
NewRooms.class2031R.projector.changed: The last slide is still loaded: this classroom, photographed from outside. You are in the picture. So is whoever held the camera. You are so creeped out that you block the memory and leave it alone.
NewRooms.class2031R.chalkboard: Someone wrote the same sentence over and over, getting smaller each time.
NewRooms.class2031R.chalkboard.changed: 'I WILL NOT LOOK OUT THE WINDOW', written again and again, smaller each time. Someone wiped a hole in the middle. From the inside, it seems. That doesn't make sense.
NewRooms.class2031R.lockers: Two grey lockers, side by side.
NewRooms.class2031R.lockers.changed: Two lockers. The first is open and holds a jacket. The second is padlocked, tagged 'Marsh'.
NewRooms.class2031R.lockers.locker_2.locked: Locker 2 is padlocked. You need the key for this.
NewRooms.class2031R.lockers.locker_2: Marsh's backpack, still packed for a school day. A note on top: 'Showcase piece: with the projects. Spare fuses: where the supplies are kept. The light is someone's enemy.'
NewRooms.class2031R.lockers.locker2_open: Marsh's backpack, still packed for a school day. A note on top: 'Showcase piece: with the projects. Spare fuses: where the supplies are kept. The light is someone's enemy.'
NewRooms.stairR.staircase: The stairs go down further than this building should allow.
NewRooms.stairR.staircase.changed: Wet footprints lead down, but the stairs are not usable. Turn back.
NewRooms.stairR.fire_door: A heavy fire door, chained shut with a padlock.
NewRooms.stairR.fire_door.changed: The chain falls off. The door does not open. Something is holding it from the other side. Keep looking for an exit.
NewRooms.stairR.fire_extinguisher: A fire extinguisher. The inspection tag expired years ago.
NewRooms.stairR.fire_extinguisher.changed: You move the extinguisher. Behind it is a keypad bolted to a bare wall.
NewRooms.stairR.fire_extinguisher.keypad: You press a few buttons. Nothing. The keypad is broken and not useful.
NewRooms.stairR.cardboard_boxes: Boxes of old exam papers. They smell damp.
NewRooms.stairR.cardboard_boxes.changed: A stack of boxes, covered in blood. Best to leave them alone.
NewRooms.stairR.emergency_light: A green EXIT sign, flickering in a bucket of murky water.
NewRooms.stairR.emergency_light.changed: The green emergency light turns red. Not a good sign, but not a useful one either.
NewRooms.teach1R.bookshelf: Dusty textbooks. A gap shows where one was pulled out recently.
NewRooms.teach1R.bookshelf.changed: Books fall to the floor. Behind them, just an ordinary wall.
NewRooms.teach1R.desks: Two desks pushed together. Both screens show the same frozen camera feed of the corridor.
NewRooms.teach1R.desks.changed: Both screens show the corridor. Something moves in the corner.
NewRooms.teach1R.safe: A steel safe with a combination dial. It will not budge.
NewRooms.teach1R.safe.changed: A dull, cracked stone. Light. Hollow. Plaster, painted. It doesn't hum. A note under it says: 'Fake. The real one is with the projects.'
NewRooms.teach1R.notice_board: A duty roster. Tonight's name has been crossed out.
NewRooms.teach1R.notice_board.changed: Red threads between photos. In the middle: an old photo of Mr. Marsh, the chemistry teacher. Someone has circled him in red.
NewRooms.teach1R.plant: A potted plant, somehow still alive. The soil is dark and wet.
NewRooms.teach1R.plant.changed: Spilled soil, and in it a small brass key on a paper tag. The tag reads '2.035 DESK'.
NewRooms.teach1R.plant.brass_key: A small key. The tag says '2.035 DESK BOX'. It opens something in a desk.
NewRooms.teach1R.plant.pov_taken: Spilled soil. Nothing else in it.
NewRooms.teach2R.filing_cabinets: Drawer after drawer of exam results. One drawer is labelled with your name.
NewRooms.teach2R.filing_cabinets.changed: A drawer of confiscated phones. One of them is ringing. Silently. You think about calling the police (112 or 911), but there is no way to dial out.
NewRooms.teach2R.desk: Stacks of ungraded exams under a lamp that should not have power.
NewRooms.teach2R.desk.changed: A red circle around a name on the placemat: Mr. Marsh, the old chemistry teacher. The ink is still wet.
NewRooms.teach2R.notice_board: Pinned notes, all in the same handwriting: 'Do not stay after six.'
NewRooms.teach2R.notice_board.changed: One note left. Pinned with a knife. The blade is clean. This is totally not happening.
NewRooms.teach2R.book_pile: A pile of confiscated things. Phones, notes, old books.
NewRooms.teach2R.book_pile.changed: A pile of old books. A tape recorder sits on top. You press play. Nothing. It doesn't work.
NewRooms.teach2R.plant: The leaves are all turned towards the door, not the light.
NewRooms.teach2R.plant.changed: Leaves are scattered all over the floor. They won't help you get out of here.
NewRooms.teach3R.sofa: A worn green sofa. There is a dent, as if someone just stood up.
NewRooms.teach3R.sofa.changed: The cushion splits. Inside, a diary. Someone hid it here.
NewRooms.teach3R.sofa.diary: Day 41. It is not in the walls. It is in the windows. I started a game of hangman on the board in 2.021. I can't finish it. It keeps finishing itself. I hide my keys where the plants are. The little box in the 2.035 desk is mine. – Marsh
NewRooms.teach3R.telephone: The old phone rings once when you touch it. Nobody is on the line.
NewRooms.teach3R.telephone.changed: You lift the receiver. Just a steady beeping, like there is no service.
NewRooms.teach3R.bookshelf: The books are all turned spine-in.
NewRooms.teach3R.bookshelf.red_book: A red book glows between the others. You open it. Every page is blank except the last: 'Nothing here.' You put it back.
NewRooms.teach3R.armchair: A small green armchair, turned to face the wall.
NewRooms.teach3R.armchair.changed: A doll sits in the armchair. It has no head. Don't spend time on it. Find another way out.
NewRooms.class2035R.chalkboard: A lesson that was never finished. The chalk is snapped in half.
NewRooms.class2035R.chalkboard.changed: A chalk arrow, pointing down. Ticked off like homework. Whoever went that way didn't come back. Look for another way out of this building.
NewRooms.class2035R.teacher_desk: A desk lamp and a single test paper. The grade is smeared.
NewRooms.class2035R.teacher_desk.changed: In the drawer: a ruler, a bell, and a small locked box with 'MARSH' scratched into the lid.
NewRooms.class2035R.teacher_desk.box.locked: Locked. It needs a small key.
NewRooms.class2035R.teacher_desk.box: Inside, a small silver key tagged 'LOCKER 2', and a note: 'Spare. Don't lose it.'
NewRooms.class2035R.teacher_desk.box_open: Inside, a small silver key tagged 'LOCKER 2', and a note: 'Spare. Don't lose it.'
NewRooms.class2035R.teacher_desk.silver_key: A small silver key. The tag says 'LOCKER 2'. It looks like a padlock key.
NewRooms.class2035R.teacher_desk.box_taken: The open box. Only the note is left.
NewRooms.class2035R.bookshelf: Atlases and dictionaries, and a row of identical spines.
NewRooms.class2035R.bookshelf.changed: Dozens of copies of the same textbook, all titled 'PLEASE DON'T'. You'll be smart and not touch them.
NewRooms.class2035R.metal_cabinet: A grey metal cabinet with fresh scratches around the lock.
NewRooms.class2035R.metal_cabinet.changed: Biology specimens. Jar 7 is empty and its lid is lying open next to it. Whatever was inside left on its own. You are not staying here for it to come back. LEAVE.
NewRooms.class2035R.notice_board: Class rules. Rule seven has been added in red pen.
NewRooms.class2035R.notice_board.changed: 'Lost: class pet. Last seen: Jar 7.' You decide not to ask what kind.
NewRooms.class2035R.globe: A small globe. Someone has scratched out one country.
NewRooms.class2035R.globe.changed: A pin, stuck in a place with no name. The globe is bleeding.
NewRooms.class2035R.globe.pin: A pin from the globe. It marked a place with no name. Nothing here to use it on.
NewRooms.class2035R.globe.pov_taken: The globe is still bleeding. The pin is gone.
NewRooms.projRoom1R.window: Closed blinds. The slats are bent, as if someone forced them apart.
NewRooms.projRoom1R.window.changed: Someone is watching from outside. When you blink, the face is gone.
NewRooms.projRoom1R.bookshelf: Programming books and old project reports. One spine has no title.
NewRooms.projRoom1R.bookshelf.changed: Books crash to the floor. Behind them, a hidden security camera, pointed at the door you came through. Someone wanted to know who came in.
NewRooms.projRoom1R.printer_3d: A 3D printer. The filament spool is almost empty.
NewRooms.projRoom1R.printer_3d.changed: The printer just finished a tiny skull. The timer says it started 0 minutes ago. You decide not to ask. You keep going and forget about it.
NewRooms.projRoom1R.whiteboard: Half a sprint planning. Most tasks are marked 'blocked'.
NewRooms.projRoom1R.whiteboard.changed: 'HELP US', in red. That was not written there a second ago.
NewRooms.projRoom1R.table_left: Tablets, a laptop and notes from a group that left in a hurry.
NewRooms.projRoom1R.table_left.changed: A red and green flyer: 'Showcase night. Final projects will be presented in the usual room. The third one along.'
NewRooms.projRoom1R.table_right: Printouts and sticky notes. Someone was counting something.
NewRooms.projRoom1R.table_right.changed: The laptop shows a frozen security camera image of the entrance. Nothing moves. You close it.
NewRooms.projRoom1R.beanbag: A beanbag. It still has the shape of whoever sat in it.
NewRooms.projRoom1R.beanbag.changed: Something was hidden in the beanbag.
NewRooms.projRoom1R.beanbag.found: A square badge, one of the three Mina talked about.
NewRooms.projRoom2R.window: Closed blinds. Cold air comes through the frame.
NewRooms.projRoom2R.window.changed: An old, dry handprint. On the outside of the glass. Whoever left it was standing where nobody can stand.
NewRooms.projRoom2R.vending_machine: The vending machine hums. Every slot is empty except one.
NewRooms.projRoom2R.vending_machine.changed: The machine glows red and drops a can with no label. It's warm. You leave it. Congratulations, you just wasted your time and got no closer to finishing the game.
NewRooms.projRoom2R.sticky_board: Sticky notes with tasks. Half of them just say 'RUN'.
NewRooms.projRoom2R.sticky_board.changed: Faded sticky notes, most of them blank. Nothing worth reading.
NewRooms.projRoom2R.workshop_table: Wires, tools and half-built electronics. It smells of solder.
NewRooms.projRoom2R.workshop_table.changed: The screen wakes up: 'LAST USER: Mr. Marsh.' A sticky note on the monitor reads: 'Showcase night is coming. The purple piece never leaves the place where we present projects.'
NewRooms.projRoom2R.tool_cabinet: A tool cabinet. One drawer does not close properly.
NewRooms.projRoom2R.tool_cabinet.changed: The drawer is empty. Someone took every tool to fix the power. Spare parts would be kept with the supplies.
NewRooms.projRoom2R.robot: A small robot prototype. Its wheels are crusted with something dark.
NewRooms.projRoom2R.robot.changed: A dusty workshop robot, unplugged and long dead. It's just scenery.
